sentences.text: Eostegostoma belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish, and is part of the family Brachaeluridae.
The genus was described by Herman and Crochard in 1977.
Eostegostoma lived between 85.7 and 27.3 million years ago, spanning from the Santonian to the Rupelian stages.
Fossils of Eostegostoma have been found in the Eocene of Belgium and the Oligocene of Alabama, United States.
